name: Local AI Development Server
summary: A local-first environment for working with language models.
description: A personal Ubuntu server with an RTX 3050 GPU and Ollama for local language-model development. Tailscale provides private remote connectivity, with hardened SSH access.
technologies: Ubuntu Linux, NVIDIA RTX 3050, Ollama, Tailscale, SSH
challenge: Local model experimentation needs usable GPU hardware and convenient remote access while keeping the server's access controlled.
approach: Run models locally through Ollama on the Ubuntu GPU server and use Tailscale for private connectivity. Harden SSH and expose access selectively through the private network.
